name: To Make a Game
source:
A short meta story about the struggles of procrastination, and never finishing the things you start. Help motivate me, and give me the confidence I need to finish something.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1889000/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一篇短篇元叙事，讲述与拖延抗争，以及开始的事总也无法完成的困境。请帮我振作起来，给我把一件事做完所需的信心。

[译自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1889000/]Steam[/url]]
